label: sparse original-phase feature at mid positions (t=3-6) on u/y/l/z/j/o after o/r/0-like context (no clean rule)
explanation: Very sparse (0.02% of steps). 94% of mass is in the original phase at t=3-6, never t<3, with a small leftover at recall_idx 1 and the delimiter. Enriched for inputs u and y (about 8x lift), then z/l/j/o, and for preceding context o, r, 0, g, a (prev_tok o: 13x lift; prev2_tok o/r: about 10x lift), and first_tok y. No combination of these explains the feature. The best trigram-style predicates reach dev F1 of only about 0.11-0.13 (precision at most 0.24), and the same n-grams are mostly inactive elsewhere, so it probably depends on a specific distributed hidden-state configuration. Magnitude is nearly flat (median 0.117, max 0.205), and no modulator was found. It does not fire at t<3, in late copy steps, or when the copy has gone wrong.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: recall_idx=1 (+3.95), orig0=y (+3.56), prev2_tok=o (+3.55), prev_tok=o (+3.50), orig1=d (+3.47), in_tok=u (+3.21). Lower it: prev3_tok=- (-3.84), orig_idx=-1 (-3.15), phase=2 (-2.02).
